## End-to-end tests (required)

E2E no longer runs on GitHub for each PR (Jack, 10 Nov 2026). Run it on your own machine before asking for a merge, and paste the summary here:

```
npm run test:e2e        # desktop + phone (see e2e/README.md for E2E_PORT / E2E_MOCK_PORT)
```
